subject.title: fix: failed cloud dispatch leaks the session's managed worktree

question: Should the Cloud UI preflight reuse or explicitly mirror the server's `auto`/`default`-to-`openclaw` normalization before this compatibility-sensitive guard lands?
rationale: The PR introduces a client-side eligibility decision that currently disagrees with the server-side runtime contract, so the exact shared-boundary implementation needs owner confirmation.

options.title: Align UI with server normalization
options.body: Recommended: treat server-default runtime identifiers as Cloud-compatible and add regression tests for the normalized path.

options.title: Keep the stricter UI block
options.body: Make default-runtime Cloud sessions intentionally unavailable only if maintainers also change and document the server contract.

recommendation.title: Align UI with server normalization
recommendation.body: Recommended: treat server-default runtime identifiers as Cloud-compatible and add regression tests for the normalized path.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and authored the proposed cross-surface repair; no independent main-history owner could be established during this read-only review.
